summary: The forum was proposed by Modi at the SCO Council of Heads of State summit in Tianjin, China, in September 2025.

stories.title: Lahore once again ranks as world's most polluted major city as AQI crosses 400
summary: The readings indicate a widespread deterioration in air quality across Punjab, with several cities experiencing hazardous pollution levels that pose serious health risks, particularly to children, elderly people and those suffering from respiratory and cardiovascular diseases.

The deterioration in air quality comes despite intensified enforcement operations by the Punjab Environment Protection and Climate Change Department against sources of pollution, particularly non-compliant brick kilns.
In the first 18 days of November, enforcement teams conducted 7,509 visits, demolished 101 kilns, sealed 161 and registered 96 FIRs, while imposing fines totalling Rs27.6m.

stories.title: Pakistan-sponsored resolution on self-determination adopted by consensus at UN
summary: The resolution, titled “Universal Realisation of the Right of Peoples to Self-Determination”, was introduced by Pakistan’s Permanent Representative to the United Nations, Ambassador Syed Haider Shah.
Ambassador Shah noted that the exercise of self-determination had transformed the course of history, enabling millions to free themselves from foreign subjugation and establish sovereign states.

stories.title: KP government plans electric bus service in 14 cities

During the subsequent proceedings, however, the deceased’s family maintained that the shooting was accidental and submitted affidavits to this effect before the court.
After recording the family members’ statements and examining the affidavits, the court approved the accused’s post-arrest bail against surety bonds of Rs200,000.
